question: For each device owner among ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list the port status, device owner, number of distinct ports, and minimum standard attribute ID; also include (for that same status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs among ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and compute the ratio of the minimum standard attribute ID to that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP).

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.status, p.device_owner, p.id, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
both AS (
  SELECT p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT MIN(standard_attr_id) AS min_id, STDDEV(standard_attr_id) AS sd
  FROM both
)
SELECT b.status,
       b.device_owner,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS distinct_ports,
       MIN(b.standard_attr_id) AS min_standard_attr_id,
       s.sd AS stddev,
       s.min_id / s.sd AS ratio
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN stats s
GROUP BY b.status, b.device_owner, s.sd, s.min_id
ORDER BY b.device_owner

dual_binding_stddev AS (
  SELECT STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) AS stddev_std_attr
  FROM ports p
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM securitygroupportbindings sgb WHERE sgb.port_id = p.id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM portsecuritybindings psb WHERE psb.port_id = p.id)
)
SELECT 
  bp.status AS port_status,
  bp.device_owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bp.id) AS distinct_port_count,
  MIN(bp.standard_attr_id) AS min_standard_attr_id,
  dbs.stddev_std_attr,
  MIN(bp.standard_attr_id) / dbs.stddev_std_attr AS ratio_min_to_stddev
FROM base_ports bp
CROSS JOIN dual_binding_stddev dbs
GROUP BY bp.device_owner, bp.status, dbs.stddev_std_attr
